title: Fitness Landscape of Large Language Model-Assisted Automated Algorithm Search

mechanism.domainTask: Fitness-landscape analysis of LLM-assisted automated algorithm search across six design tasks
mechanism.populationDetail: The EoH experiment maintains a population of 20 candidate algorithms per run; the paper also compares other configured sizes.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The paper discusses populations and returns a best algorithm but does not specify a separate elite archive or preservation logic.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The generic LAS formulation says selected offspring are added and candidates removed, but the EoH experiment's concrete update/survivor rule is not given.
mechanism.generationDetail: E1/E2 are described as exploratory and M1/M2 as parent-refinement operators, but edit scope and exact parent-offspring operations are not detailed.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Candidate quality is task performance, such as average route length across instances; no additional evaluation metadata is reported as search feedback.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The generic formulation says parent candidates come from the current population according to a selection strategy, but the EoH experiment does not specify that strategy or parent arity.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: The paper's main contribution is graph-based characterization of fitness landscapes and code-similarity measurements, rather than a search mechanism; this analysis contribution is outside the current mechanism taxonomy.
